scope: Targeted primary-source review of biological weak-light processing, completion and computational neighbors; not an exhaustive survey or reproduction.
interpretation_rules: Biological observations, engineering abstractions and OWAC hypotheses are distinct.
Occlusion, low photon counts, spatial memory and multisensory tasks must not be conflated.
Read scope is recorded; no full-paper review or experimental reproduction is claimed.
N01-N06 are mechanism questions, not established novel architectures or mandatory serial modules.
Current deployment status is taken from repository records, not from these papers.
